source_text: {ΠΑΛΛ.} Εὖ ἔφης. {ΚΥΡ.} Ἐν τάξει δὴ οὖν τῇ ἀσυγχύτῳ τὰ ἱερά· πρέποι γὰρ ἂν ὡδὶ, καὶ οὐχ ἑτεροίως ἔχειν. {ΠΑΛΛ.} Εὖ λέγεις. {ΚΥΡ.} Κοινὸν δὲ ὥσπερ ἀμφοῖν ἀπονέμει κλῆρον, τὰς τῶν ὑπὸ χεῖρα δωροφορίας, καὶ ἅπερ ἀνοίσειέ τις εἰς ἀνάθημα καὶ θυσίαν τῷ Θεῷ, ταῦτα δεῖν εἶναί φησιν ἱερέων τε ἅμα καὶ Λευϊτῶν. Ἔφη γὰρ οὕτω πρὸς Ἀαρὼν ὁ τῶν ὅλων Θεός· «Ἐν τῇ γῇ αὐτῶν οὐ κληρονομήσεις, καὶ μερὶς οὐκ ἔσται σοι ἐν αὐτοῖς· ὅτι ἐγὼ μερίς σου καὶ κληρονομία σου ἐν μέσῳ τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ. Καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Λευΐ· Ἰδοὺ
pass_a_gloss: §10 dual gloss: μερίς / portion; κληρονομία / inheritance … Pass A ≠ Pass B. Theme: Unconfused sacred order; Lord the portion; no land lot for Levi
pass_b_english: Cyril: So then in the unconfused order are the sacred things; for thus it would be fitting, and not to have otherwise.

Cyril: And as it were a common lot he apportions to both, the gift-bearings of those under hand, and as many as one should bring up unto a dedication and sacrifice to God, these he says must be of priests and Levites together. For thus the God of the wholes said toward Aaron: ‘In their land you will not inherit, and a portion will not be for you in them; because I am your portion and your inheritance in midst of the sons of Israel. And to the sons of Levi: Behold I have given every tenth in Israel in a lot instead of their liturgies, as many as they themselves liturgize a liturgy in the tent of the witness, and the sons of Israel will no longer come forward into the tent of the witness to take a death-bearing sin, and the Levite himself will liturgize the liturgy of the tent of the witness, and they themselves will take their sins; eternal lawful into their generations, and in midst of sons of Israel they will not inherit an inheritance; because the tenths of the sons of Israel as many as if they should set apart to Lord, a taking-away I have given to the Levites in a lot; through this I have said to them: In midst of sons of Israel they will not inherit a lot.’ (Numbers 18:20–24) And in Deuteronomy at least having as it were cycled the same word, somehow thus he says: ‘There will not be for the priests the Levites, for whole tribe of Levi, a portion, nor a lot with Israel. Fruits of Lord their lot; they will eat them. And a lot will not be for them in their brothers; Lord himself his lot, according as he said to him. And this the judgment of the priests the things from the people from those sacrificing the victims, whether a calf, or a sheep; and you will give the arm to the priest, and the jaws, and the fourth-stomach, and the firstfruits of your grain, and of your wine, and of your oil, and the firstfruit of the shearings of your sheep you will give him; because Lord chose him from all your tribes, to stand before Lord the God, to liturgize and to bless upon his name, he and his sons all the days.’ (Deuteronomy 18:1–5) So then observe how unarranged with the people is the sacred race, and somehow has been marked-off from the others; and not only by the practices according to the liturgy, but already also by the difference of the hope. For for those living through the earth-fallen life, and having clung to the earthly and thirsted the temporary, and driving past in equal to shadows, it would reasonably be said: ‘This is your portion, this your lot, a portion of your disobeying me, says Lord.’ (Jeremiah 13:25) And for those having prized the holy and blameless life, and already chosen-out through virtue, very well must be said: ‘In their land you will not inherit, and a portion will not be for you in them; because I am your portion and your inheritance,’
